author_notes: Deterministic independent LTC fit of the shared Project HS GGX model (alpha=max(roughness squared,0.002)). No imported coefficient table. Energies are dimensionless; the renderer applies authored area-light radiance and emitter geometry. The NdotV=0 endpoint is its positive 0.00001 limit. Reference method: Heitz, Dupuy, Hill and Neubelt, SIGGRAPH 2016.
